sentences.japanese: それは核ミサイルをボタン一つで操作し合う戦争になるだろう。
sentences.english: It will be a push-button war of nuclear missiles.

sentences.japanese: その都市には数カ所の核シェルターがある。
sentences.english: There are a few nuclear bomb shelters in the city.

sentences.japanese: 世界的な全面核戦争が起これば、地球規模でこの「核の冬」が数カ月間も続くと言われています。
sentences.english: If there's a world-wide all-out nuclear war it's said that there will be a "nuclear winter" all over the planet for several months.

sentences.japanese: 日本で核の危機が起きたのは大変です。
sentences.english: It is dreadful that a nuclear crisis has hit Japan.

sentences.japanese: 国際社会が日本での核の危険に関して警告を発している。
sentences.english: The international community is issuing warnings regarding the nuclear threat in Japan.
